snippet.title: Blaster Master Zero 2 - Official Trailer (PlayStation 4)
snippet.description:
Mutant blasting action is back on PlayStation 4!
Join Jason, Eve, and Fred on an intergalactic journey when Blaster Master Zero 2 comes to PS4 on June 29, 2020
!
Official Website: http://blastermaster-zero.com/en/

The side-scrolling/top-down hybrid action adventure gameplay returns with a brand new sequel to "Blaster Master Zero"! Experience the yet-untold story of Jason and Eve after defeating Earth's mutant scourge as they venture into the depths of space in their new battle tank, "GAIA-SOPHIA"!

The story of Blaster Master Zero 2 begins a few months after the events of the first game, where the main protagonist Jason saves planet Earth from the mutants. Eve has been infected by mutant cells that are slowly corrupting her body, so together with Jason and Fred, they board G-SOPHIA and begin an intergalactic journey to Eve's home planet, Sophia, in hopes of finding a cure for the mutant infection.

Twitter (Inti Creates): https://twitter.com/IntiCreatesEN
Facebook (Inti Creates): https://www.facebook.com/inticreates/

Product Details
Title： Blaster Master Zero 2
Hardware： PlayStation 4 
Genre： Action Adventure
Rating： Everyone 10+ (Mild Fantasy Violence, Mild Langage), PEGI 12
Release Date： June 29th, 2020
Players：1 Player,
Price： $9.99, €9.99, £8.99
Developer： Inti Creates

※The Blaster Master Zero series was born after Inti Creates acquired the license for the original Blaster Master game for the NES from Sunsoft.
